bio.text: Jeff Wadlin is the Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. Senate in Arkansas in 2026, having advanced from the party's February 22, 2026 convention.

According to the campaign website, Wadlin was born in Richmond, Virginia, lives in Bentonville, and studied aerospace and mechanical engineering at the University of Virginia before earning an MBA from Northwestern University.
The site says Wadlin worked for Caterpillar and Capital One, co-founded an online auto-parts salvage company, ran membership at Sam's Club, and later started a consulting business.
